previousRule: Browse production coverage asserted only Fabric Knowledge Pattern, Texture, Character / style and Finish / sheen because the visual colour cache covered 33.4% of eligible fabrics.
newRule: Browse treats Colour and Curtains From price as manufacturer-governed facts; Pattern, Texture, Character / style and Finish / sheen remain Fabric Knowledge facets. All filters combine over the same eligible Fabric Master catalogue.
reason: Production audit proved every eligible Fabric Master preserves a supplier colourway (9,248/9,248) and controlled colour-family mapping covers 7,380 records without replacing supplier truth. Fabric Knowledge colour remains supplementary only.
ownerApprovedDecision: The owner explicitly required Colour as a primary Browse facet sourced from manufacturer colourways, Price from the existing governed guide-price projection, and no Fabric Knowledge requirement for Browse eligibility.
